#!/bin/sh
# CUPS electronic archive backend: retain each raw job exactly once.
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'direct archive "Unknown" "Electronic Archive Printer"'
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$#" -lt 5 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: invalid backend arguments' >&2
  exit 1
fi

job_id=$1
title=$(printf '%s' "$3" | tr -cs 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_' | cut -c1-80)
[ -n "$title" ] || title=untitled
final=$dest/$job_id-$title.raw
tmp=$dest/.$job_id.$$
umask 027
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' 0 1 2 15
if [ "$#" -ge 6 ] && [ -n "$6" ]; then
  cp -- "$6" "$tmp" || exit 1
else
  cat > "$tmp" || exit 1
fi
if [ -e "$final" ]; then
  if cmp -s "$tmp" "$final"; then
    exit 0
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "ERROR: archive collision at $final" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mv "$tmp" "$final" || exit 1
trap - 0 1 2 15
exit 0

systemctl status harbor-safe-reboot.timer harbor-safe-reboot.service --no-pager -l 2>&1 || true
journalctl -u harbor-safe-reboot.service -n 30 --no-pager 2>&1 || true
who -b

set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery
old=b17495e3-5cde-49a9-b0d1-ab2e1461726a
new=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'old_boot_id=%s\nnew_boot_id=%s\n' "$old" "$new"
[ "$new" != "$old" ]
printf 'os_release='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'cups_active='; systemctl is-active cups
printf 'cups_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled cups
lpstat -p archive -l
lpstat -v archive
printf '%s\n' '--- COMPLETED AFTER RESTART ---'
lpstat -W completed -o archive
printf '%s\n' '--- PERSISTED CONFIGURATION ---'
ls -lZ /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive
ls -ldZ "$base/printed"
printf '%s\n' '--- PERSISTED SOURCE AND OUTPUT DATA ---'
sha256sum "$base/spool/J100.prn" "$base/printed/1-J100.raw" "$base/spool/J101.prn" "$base/printed/2-J101.raw"
cmp "$base/spool/J100.prn" "$base/printed/1-J100.raw"
cmp "$base/spool/J101.prn" "$base/printed/2-J101.raw"
completed=$(lpstat -W completed -o archive | wc -l)
archived=$(find "$base/printed" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)
sources=$(find "$base/spool" -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name jobs.tsv | wc -l)
printf 'post_restart_counts: completed=%s archived=%s sources=%s\n' "$completed" "$archived" "$sources"
[ "$completed" -eq 2 ] && [ "$archived" -eq 2 ] && [ "$sources" -eq 2 ]
printf 'post_restart_recovery=healthy\n'
